title.narrative: Ukraine Joint Programme on conflict-related sexual violence (JP_CRSV)

description.narrative: Four PUNOs, namely the O-SRSG-SVC, UNDP, UN Women and UNFPA will take part in the Joint Programme aiming to push the implementation of the Framework of Cooperation forward by responding to the immediate needs that the Inter-Ministerial Working Group is experiencing in terms of human resources. The joint project is anchored in providing technical support for the Implementation Plan, collaborating with civil society organizations and first responders. In response to the situation and challenges indicated above, UNDP in Ukraine is committed to delivering capacity-building initiatives and filling critical gaps in terms of assistance to survivors as assessed by the WPA Unit.Primary goal of the project outcome will be to strengthen capacity of the national authorities for victim-centred and gender-sensitive response to CRSV and support to victims and survivors. As a result the rights and needs of CRSV survivors in Ukraine will be properly addressed.Output 1. ensure strengthened and coordinated CRSV prevention and response in Ukraine, that will be achieved through three main workstreams: (1) strengthening of coordination around service provision including by integrating a survivor-centred approach and ensuring that services are made available where they are most needed, (2) policy development, (3) capacity building and trainings.
